Flow.description:
Screen subflow used when an asset return is processed or moved back to inventory. Move to Inventory hops through Returned (to snapshot assignment history) then Inventory (wipe lifecycle fields except First Stage Date). Retire remains a single-step status change.
2026-08-03: INC3-91 Phase 6 - The Retire Asset branch no longer creates Asset_Assignment__c via the legacy shared writer (Create_Retirement_Assignment removed - it has no other callers left in this org). Initial_Retirement_Values now stamps Get_Asset.Retirement_Date__c / Retirement_Reason__c directly (mirrored onto Asset in Phase 0) instead of building an assetAssignmentToCreate record; that now-unused variable was removed. A new Update_Retired_Asset record update stamps Status="Retired" + Status_Change_Notes__c (via new retireNotes formula, folding in Retire_Notes__c) + Retirement_Date__c/Retirement_Reason__c on the Asset, triggering Asset_After_Create_Assignment_on_Status_Change to create the assignment and stamp Current_Assignment__c. This branch is single-asset only (no children), matching prior behavior. 2026-08-12: Move to Inventory now stamps Status=Returned and Return_Date__c first (practice account and lifecycle fields still populated), then a second DML sets Status=Inventory, moves Account to Inventory Account, clears Parent, and wipes assignment lifecycle fields except First_Stage_Date__c. Return Date lives on the Returned assignment only. 2026-10-08: AP - OPS-403: return and retire date is now required (no default of today) and labelled as the date the equipment arrived at the office; the same date now also stamps Billing_End_Date__c on the Returned step and on the retire path (Returned-before-retire and Retired asset updates).

formulas.name: retireNotes
formulas.expression: IF(ISBLANK({!Retire_Notes1}), "Retired via Manage Asset console", "Retired via Manage Asset console. Retire Notes: " & {!Retire_Notes1})

formulas.name: retireReturnedNotes
formulas.expression: IF(ISBLANK({!Retirement_Date1}), "Returned via Process Return (retire)", "Returned via Process Return (retire). Return Date: " & TEXT({!Retirement_Date1}))

formulas.name: returnedNotes
formulas.expression: IF(ISBLANK({!Move_to_Inventory_Date}), "Returned via Process Return", "Returned via Process Return. Return Date: " & TEXT({!Move_to_Inventory_Date}))
